prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Generate one production atlas of exactly FOUR independent original in-game UI action icons for the Daoist chibi game Linghu. Requested square 1024×1024, regular two columns by two rows, four 512×512 cells. True RGBA transparency, no background plate, shadows, text, words, numbers, UI mockup, grid lines or elements beyond the four little badges. Fully contain each badge within 320×320 in its cell, precisely centered, with much transparent padding on all four sides and separated from the other badges.
Image 1 and 2 are the primary approved style only. Image 3 is the existing in-game icon atlas for finish and scale cues only; match the emerald/jade and aged warm-gold palette and painterly gently bevelled edges of the plus and ready jade seals, simplify their ornament greatly. Do not copy any source icon. The final icons are placed beside real text at 16–32 px, so the symbol must be the first thing seen. 
Each of the four icons is a uniform round DEEP TEAL JADE disk with a clear fairly thin warm-gold rim, soft hand-painted tactile material, optionally one tiny cloud engraving near the perimeter. Use a BIG SIMPLE WARM IVORY symbol with a muted gold bevel that reads against the dark jade. Minimal fine decoration, straight-on orthographic view, no perspective, no drop shadow. The icon has opaque body and clean true transparent outside. Match diameter and border thickness across all four. Do not turn them into elaborate jewelry or 3D plastic. 
Exact semantic placement: 
TOP LEFT PLAY: a single filled right-pointing rounded equilateral triangle, no tail or stem and no gap in its fill, with a rounded point. 
TOP RIGHT PAUSE: exactly two upright solid ivory bars, both equal height and equal width, with a wide dark teal gap between them. No extra bar, no baseline, no letters. 
BOTTOM LEFT CLOSE: one simple bold symmetrical diagonal X, formed by two broad strokes at 45 degrees, rounded endpoints, visibly diagonal and never a plus. Keep the overall disk jade, no bright red.
BOTTOM RIGHT NEXT: one unmistakable filled right-pointing straight arrow, with a horizontal stem extending left and a large triangular right arrowhead; the shaft is broad and integrated into the head. The stem is clearly visible to distinguish it from the PLAY triangle. No second arrow, no triangle-only, no chevron, no line.
Do not render captions. Keep all four interiors legible and contrasting, stable bold silhouettes at 16 px. Keep actual empty transparent gutters and every object complete.
